name: LAN Scanner
description: Find the devices on your own local network (private ranges only): names, makers, how fast they reply, what they seem to be, and what changed since last time.
changelog: More features: the maker of each device, how fast it replied, service names for open ports, 40 common ports with --full or your own with --ports, names you give devices, --save and --diff to see what is new or gone since the last scan, --sort, --up, and --json or --csv output.
